For seed 1, the pixel at x 0, y 0 and the red channel get the normal number n = -1.8715. With sigma 10 on a flat gray of 128, the red value becomes 128 + 10 x -1.8715 = 109.29, which rounds to 109. The same seed and position always give the same n.
